pages.text: Mod improves the replacement of plants in pots.$(br2)The vanilla behavior by default puts a removed plant from its pot into the empty hand and this prevents removing from any subsequent pots.$(br2)After the change, the plant will go to the first empty slot on the hotbar$(br)

$(br)or to a slot in your inventory that already has this plant.$(br2)Additionally, by clicking on the pot with another plant, it will be replaced. This also applies to the different colors of the colored plants.$(br2)Sound notifications of actions - insertion, removal and replacement - have also been added.$(br)
